commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Noah Cadiou goes off the pitch and Martin Bley (Lorient) comes on.
90+4' Lorient take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' Substitution. Folarin Balogun did his best and is replaced by Paris Brunner (Monaco).
90+2' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) replacing Igor Silva.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) comes onto the pitch for Theo Le Bris.

90+1' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.

87' 1 - 3 Dermane Karim (Lorient) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Philipp Kohn is just a bystander as the ball flies off the post into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:3.
85' 1 - 2 Goal! Dermane Karim plays it to Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Philipp Kohn. 1:2.
84' Vanderson (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yvon Mvogo, who smothers the ball.

83' That was close by Dermane Karim (Lorient)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
80' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) jumps into a tackle and Willy Delajod signals a foul. It's a free kick to Monaco, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
76' 1 - 1 Goal 1:1! Ansu Fati (Monaco) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
76' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Ansu Fati (Monaco) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Dermane Karim (Lorient) is replacing Pablo Pagis.
75' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to substitute Bamba Dieng and he is replaced by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
73' Ball possession – 62:38.
70' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
69' It's time for a substitution. Ansu Fati (Monaco) comes on in place of Jordan Teze.
69' Sebastien Pocognoli prepares a substitution. Kassoum Ouattara is replaced by Vanderson (Monaco).

68' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Bamba Dieng (Lorient) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
65' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
62' Noah Cadiou (Lorient) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mika Biereth walks off the pitch to be replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
60' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
59' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) causes Yvon Mvogo little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.

57' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Yvon Mvogo was alert and the score remains the same.

56' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
55' Good work from Lorient as they win a corner.

55' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Lorient will take a corner.
52' Lorient control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
50' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and it's Folarin Balogun (Monaco) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
46' Mika Biereth (Monaco) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45+2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Monaco.
45+1' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
45+1' Mika Biereth (Monaco) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. Monaco win a corner.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
43' Monaco fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
41' Monaco couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Monaco.
38' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lorient due to an offside in the build-up play.
38' The Lorient players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
38' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
36' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
35' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Philipp Kohn makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' A cross into the box from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is cleared.
29' Mika Biereth (Monaco) commits a foul and Willy Delajod immediately signals a free kick.

27' What a chance that is! Pablo Pagis (Lorient) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
25' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
23' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
22' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
20' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
17' Lorient failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
16' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
14' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.

12' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Mika Biereth (Monaco), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
10' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
9' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

8' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.

7' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Yvon Mvogo displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
6' An attempted cross from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is cleared.
4' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is out of play. Monaco will take a throw-in.
2' Yvon Mvogo pulls off a great save to deny Folarin Balogun (Monaco), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Willy Delajod.
